hero.title: Collaborative event playlists, without forcing guests to sign up.
hero.description: Synqit gives hosts a shareable link. Guests open it, search songs, and contribute in seconds while tracks land directly in the host provider playlist.
hero.helper: Built for fast guest contribution on mobile, tablet, and desktop.

why.title: Why hosts choose Synqit for event playlists
why.description: Structured for clarity and speed: create, share, collect tracks, moderate.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: Connect provider, create the event playlist, and generate a magic link.
how.step2Body: Guests open the link and contribute songs from the host provider catalog.
how.step3Body: Host reviews tracks, removes items, and closes the event when ready.

cards.hostBody: Connect provider, create event, copy the magic link in under a minute.
cards.guestBody: Guests open the link, search tracks, and contribute without account creation.
cards.providerBody: Tracks are searched against and added to the host provider account directly.
